summary: Iteration 2: Verified migration from localStorage to shared FastAPI+MongoDB backend. Backend pytest: 5/5 passed (list/create/update/delete items with GET verification, 404 handling, categories list/add/duplicate-409/reserved-409/empty-400). Frontend Playwright: 11/11 flows passed — initial 5 non-archive seed cards visible, Add Item modal POSTs, edit PUTs, favorite toggles PUT, search filters (empty-state on no match), category nav, sort Newest/A-Z/Favorites, New Category via window.prompt with duplicate/reserved guarding, dark/light theme toggle, delete via confirm dialog DELETEs. CROSS-BROWSER PERSISTENCE verified: item created in default context appeared in a fresh browser context (no shared localStorage) — proves data is truly server-side/shared. Cleaned up TEST_ prefixed items/categories after runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.on_event('startup') uses `logger` before it's defined at module scope — works only because event fires after module import, but still fragile. Move logging config above the seed handler.
server.py: `add_category` performs two full-collection scans on every add; small scale fine, but a unique index on `name` (case-insensitive) would be cleaner.
App.js: Optimistic favorite toggle rolls back on error but other mutations (create/edit/delete) show no user-visible error (only console.error). Consider a toast on failure.
App.js: `addCategory` uses window.prompt/alert — works but not test-friendly; a proper modal with data-testid would be more robust.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 items on startup if vault_items empty. No test seed data left behind (TEST_ items/categories cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env fallback. Cross-browser persistence has been verified with a fresh browser.new_context() opening the app URL and finding the created item. If retesting, remember to cleanup Mongo collections vault_items/vault_categories with TEST_ prefix.
